newsitem.title: LATVIA: MIDSUMMER LINGERS AS BOURSE VOLUME DIPS.
newsitem.headline: MIDSUMMER LINGERS AS BOURSE VOLUME DIPS.

text.p: * Total turnover came to 33,000 lats against Friday's pre-midsummer session of 51,000 lats.
* The bourse index rose 1.69 points or 0.44 percent to 384.18, Rietumu index grew by 0.15 percent to 153.33.
* Confectionary maker Staburadze led the official list, trading 10,800 lats. It rose two santimes to 2.71 lats.
* On secondary list, where 22 stocks out of 32 were not traded, Olainfarm as the only active share on volume of 4,300 lats. It remained steady at 2.55 lats.
Latvia's market was hungover after the four-day midsummer weekend, with volume falling as most stocks were not even quoted, dealers said.
Total turnover came to a paltry 33,000 lats against 51,000 lats Friday and the bouse index rose 1.69 points or 0.44 percent to 384.18. The Rietumu index grew by 0.15 percent to 153.33.
Confectionary producer Staburadze led the official list on trade of 10,800 lats. It rose two santimes to 2.71 lats.
Unibanka also edged up two santimes to 3.35 lats and had volume of 7,100 lats.
On the secondary list, where 22 stocks out of 32 were not traded, paharmaceutical producer Olainfarm was the only active share on volume of 4,300 lats. It held steady at 2.55 lats.
